title: Roadmap - Releases, Upcoming Features and Improvements

pageBlocks.byLine: Welcome to EagleEye's public roadmap! This is a live document and will be updated regularly

items.title: Microsoft Graph Integration
items.description: Enable seamless access to Microsoft 365 data, allowing EagleEye to scan emails nightly, extract insights, and enhance tagging accuracy based on structured communication data from Outlook and other Microsoft services.

items.title: Synchronization of historical data
items.description: Implement a historical data sync feature to allow users to analyze past email trends, providing deeper insights into communication patterns and workload distribution

items.title: Customer Portal
items.description: Develop a self-service portal where customers can access Power BI reports for email insights, manage tags for better categorization, and track email synchronization jobs.

items.title: Customer Instance Setup
items.description: Automate the provisioning of dedicated EagleEye instances for customers, ensuring secure data isolation, streamlined onboarding, and customized configurations for enterprise users.

items.title: GitHub Integration
items.description: Bring GitHub issues and pull requests into EagleEye, so they are scanned, AI-tagged and reported on like email. Already live: the Issues report (Overview, Mentions, Opened and Closed tabs), the Pull Requests report (Overview, Mentions, Opened and Approved tabs), custom AI tags for GitHub, and daily and manual GitHub scans. Next: comments as messages of their own, webhook triggers on GitHub tags, and linking a person's GitHub and email identities.

items.title: Teams Integration
items.description: Enable Microsoft Teams integration to analyze chat-based communications alongside email insights, providing a holistic view of team collaboration and workload balance

items.title: Email Response Time Analytics
items.description: Implement analytics to track and visualize email response times, helping organizations identify bottlenecks, improve communication efficiency, and enhance customer support effectiveness.
